sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.98/2025 registered at Police Station Tala, District Maihar, for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code.

The applicant is in jail since 24.05.2025.
2.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the victim has lodged two FIRs against the applicant, in which, stating the incident of 18.05.2025, first FIR was lodged on 19.05.2025 on the ground of assault made by the applicant and his family members upon her whereas the second FIR was lodged on 24.05.2025.

In the first FIR, nowhere it has been mentioned by the victim that on the false ground of marriage, the applicant established physical relations with her whereas in the second FIR, it has been mentioned by her that both the parties (applicant and complainant) were in NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:36821 2 MCRC-26252-2025 relations since June,
2020 and lastly, physical relations were established between them on 20.05.2024.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that on the first time, when physical relations were established, the victim was a major and with her own consent, relations were established,
hence, no case is made out against the applicant.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant is not required in investigation.
Trial will take time to be concluded and hence, applicant be enlarged on bail.

4. Learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the bail application and submitted that on an assurance given by the applicant, physical relations were established between the parties, but the applicant is going to marry with some other person and when this fact came to the knowledge of the victim that the Ravi Shankar Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173170135/
1 applicant's Tilak ceremony is scheduled for 18.05.2025, she went to his house and told the fact to his family members and on that, they assaulted her and then only, this FIR has been lodged.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the looking to the nature of offence, the applicant is not entitled for bail.

5. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Considering the facts and circumstances brought on record coupled with the fact that trial will take time to be concluded, this Court deems it fit to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant - Ravishankar Choudhary shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:36821 3 MCRC-26252-2025 the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, Misc. Criminal Case stands disposed of.
